import heapq

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.N = size
        self.edge_list = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(size)]

    def add(self, u, v, cap, w):
        idx = len(self.edge_list)
        self.edge_list.append((u, len(self.adj[u])))
        self.adj[u].append(self._Edge(v, len(self.adj[v]), cap, w))
        self.adj[v].append(self._Edge(u, len(self.adj[u]) - 1, 0, -w))
        return idx

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, src, dst, cap, flow, cost):
            self.src = src
            self.dst = dst
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost

    def get(self, i):
        u, pos = self.edge_list[i]
        f = self.adj[u][pos]
        r = self.adj[f.dst][f.rev]
        return self.Edge(u, f.dst, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost)

    def list_edges(self):
        res = []
        for i in range(len(self.edge_list)):
            u, pos = self.edge_list[i]
            f = self.adj[u][pos]
            r = self.adj[f.dst][f.rev]
            res.append(self.Edge(u, f.dst, f.cap + r.cap, r.cap, f.cost))
        return res

    def _refine(self, s, t):
        self.d = [4294967295] * self.N
        self.par = [-1] * self.N
        self.par_edge = [-1] * self.N
        self.seen = [False] * self.N
        heap = [s]
        self.d[s] = 0
        while heap:
            v = heapq.heappop(heap) & 4294967295
            if self.seen[v]:
                continue
            self.seen[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.adj[v])):
                e = self.adj[v][i]
                if self.seen[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                rc = e.cost - self.phi[e.to] + self.phi[v]
                if self.d[e.to] > self.d[v] + rc:
                    self.d[e.to] = self.d[v] + rc
                    self.par[e.to] = v
                    self.par_edge[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(heap, ((self.d[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.seen[t]:
            return False
        for i in range(self.N):
            if not self.seen[i]:
                continue
            self.phi[i] -= self.d[t] - self.d[i]
        return True

    def frontier(self, s, t, limit=4294967295):
        self.phi = [0] * self.N
        self.d = [4294967295] * self.N
        self.par = [-1] * self.N
        self.par_edge = [-1] * self.N
        self.seen = [False] * self.N
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        last_cost = -1
        points = [(flow, cost)]
        while flow < limit:
            if not self._refine(s, t):
                break
            c = limit - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                c = min(c, self.adj[self.par[v]][self.par_edge[v]].cap)
                v = self.par[v]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.adj[self.par[v]][self.par_edge[v]]
                e.cap -= c
                self.adj[v][e.rev].cap += c
                v = self.par[v]
            d = -self.phi[s]
            flow += c
            cost += c * d
            if last_cost == d:
                points.pop()
            points.append((flow, cost))
            last_cost = d
        return points

    def send(self, s, t, limit=4294967295):
        return self.frontier(s, t, limit)[-1]

    class _Edge:
        def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
            self.to = to
            self.rev = rev
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class Graph {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int src, dst, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, int f, int co) : src(s), dst(d), cap(c), flow(f), cost(co) {}
    };

    struct _Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long long cap, cost;
        _Edge(int t, int r, long long c, long long co) : to(t), rev(r), cap(c), cost(co) {}
    };

    int N;
    vector<pair<int, int>> edge_list;
    vector<vector<_Edge>> adj;

    Graph(int size) : N(size) {
        edge_list.clear();
        adj.resize(size);
    }

    int add(int u, int v, long long cap, long long w) {
        int idx = edge_list.size();
        edge_list.push_back({u, (int)adj[u].size()});
        adj[u].push_back(_Edge(v, (int)adj[v].size(), cap, w));
        adj[v].push_back(_Edge(u, (int)adj[u].size() - 1, 0, -w));
        return idx;
    }

    Edge get(int i) {
        int u = edge_list[i].first;
        int pos = edge_list[i].second;
        _Edge f = adj[u][pos];
        _Edge r = adj[f.to][f.rev];
        return Edge(u, f.to, (int)(f.cap + r.cap), (int)r.cap, (int)f.cost);
    }

    vector<Edge> list_edges() {
        vector<Edge> res;
        for (int i = 0; i < edge_list.size(); i++) {
            int u = edge_list[i].first;
            int pos = edge_list[i].second;
            _Edge f = adj[u][pos];
            _Edge r = adj[f.to][f.rev];
            res.push_back(Edge(u, f.to, (int)(f.cap + r.cap), (int)r.cap, (int)f.cost));
        }
        return res;
    }

    vector<long long> d, phi;
    vector<int> par, par_edge;
    vector<bool> seen;

    bool _refine(int s, int t) {
        d.assign(N, LLONG_MAX);
        par.assign(N, -1);
        par_edge.assign(N, -1);
        seen.assign(N, false);
        priority_queue<pair<long long, int>, vector<pair<long long, int>>, greater<pair<long long, int>>> heap;
        d[s] = 0;
        heap.push({0, s});
        
        while (!heap.empty()) {
            auto top = heap.top();
            heap.pop();
            int v = top.second;
            if (seen[v]) continue;
            seen[v] = true;
            if (v == t) break;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < adj[v].size(); i++) {
                _Edge e = adj[v][i];
                if (seen[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                long long rc = e.cost - phi[e.to] + phi[v];
                if (d[e.to] > d[v] + rc) {
                    d[e.to] = d[v] + rc;
                    par[e.to] = v;
                    par_edge[e.to] = i;
                    heap.push({d[e.to], e.to});
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (!seen[t]) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (!seen[i]) continue;
            phi[i] -= d[t] - d[i];
        }
        return true;
    }

    vector<pair<long long, long long>> frontier(int s, int t, long long limit = LLONG_MAX) {
        phi.assign(N, 0);
        d.assign(N, LLONG_MAX);
        par.assign(N, -1);
        par_edge.assign(N, -1);
        seen.assign(N, false);
        long long flow = 0;
        long long cost = 0;
        long long last_cost = -1;
        vector<pair<long long, long long>> points;
        points.push_back({flow, cost});
        
        while (flow < limit) {
            if (!_refine(s, t)) break;
            long long c = limit - flow;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                c = min(c, adj[par[v]][par_edge[v]].cap);
                v = par[v];
            }
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                _Edge& e = adj[par[v]][par_edge[v]];
                e.cap -= c;
                adj[v][e.rev].cap += c;
                v = par[v];
            }
            long long d_val = -phi[s];
            flow += c;
            cost += c * d_val;
            if (last_cost == d_val) {
                points.pop_back();
            }
            points.push_back({flow, cost});
            last_cost = d_val;
        }
        return points;
    }

    pair<long long, long long> send(int s, int t, long long limit = LLONG_MAX) {
        auto res = frontier(s, t, limit);
        return {res.back().first, res.back().second};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    long long a1, a2, a3;
    cin >> a1 >> a2 >> a3;
    long long b1, b2, b3;
    cin >> b1 >> b2 >> b3;

    Graph g(8);
    g.add(0, 1, a1, 0);
    g.add(0, 2, a2, 0);
    g.add(0, 3, a3, 0);
    g.add(4, 7, b1, 0);
    g.add(5, 7, b2, 0);
    g.add(6, 7, b3, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
            long long cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
            g.add(i, j, LLONG_MAX, cost);
        }
    }

    auto result = g.send(0, 7);
    long long ans1 = result.second;
    long long ans2 = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1);
    cout << ans1 << " " << ans2 << endl;

    return 0;
}
